# ThruHike Crew

ThruHike Crew brings together people interested in helping build ThruHike. Participation is free and voluntary, with no required hours or fees. Possible contribution areas include testing, design, routes, content, documentation, translation, ideas, and code. Programming experience and money are not prerequisites.

**Public Crew page:** https://thruhike.ru/crew. Website applications and repository Issues are disabled; product contributions are not currently accepted. Do not submit personal information.

Participation does not guarantee compensation, income, equity, tokens, or other rights. Possible future co-ownership or community governance would require separate owner decisions and appropriate legal arrangements; neither is automatic or guaranteed.
